thread:
alex: Quick sync — want to align on the ops/econ recommendations pilot scope and launch constraints. Customers pushing batching + quant recs + eval alerts. Thoughts?

maya: +1. We should separate the advisory surface from the autopilot changes. customers want prescriptive recs first, autopilot later. :thumbsup:

sam: Agree. Prescriptive recs = lower risk. Need clear guardrails for quantization suggestions (model/precision combos).

ingrid: For prescriptive recs do we ship as console suggestions + API flag? or start with a report export?

alex: Idea: console + API endpoint for recommendations (read-only). No automatic deployments in v1. Launch criteria: safety checks, perf delta bounds, and pilot success with 3 customers.

maya: Can we define perf delta bounds now? My proposal: CPU/GPU token latency regression <= 10% and p99 increase <= 15ms for typical prompts. Cost savings target >= 12% for long-tail workloads.

sam: Also need eval-triggered alerts gating. We shouldn't ship recs without an eval monitor. Requirement: false-positive rate for regression alerts < 5% on our eval set.

ingrid: I'll draft an acceptance checklist. Also flagging rollout: pilot must include 2 hosted and 1 dedicated customer (to validate routing/batching differences).

alex: Love that. Action items: @maya produce perf target doc, @sam list eval metrics and alert thresholds, @ingrid draft pilot runbook and customer ask. Product-bot: create ticket for pilot.

product-bot: Created ticket PROD-19842: "Ops econ recommendations pilot — prescriptive recs + eval alerts" assigned to product. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROD-19842

maya: Quick config sketch for recommendation payloads:
```json
{
  "model": "gptx-13b",
  "recommendations": [
    {"type":"quantize","precision":"int8","expected_savings_pct":18},
    {"type":"batch","batch_size":8,"expected_latency_ms":+5}
  ],
  "confidence": 0.86
}
```

sam: That looks good. We should add a reason field tied to eval signals (e.g., "stable perplexity within delta, latency gain estimate") so customers can trust recs.

ingrid: Timeline check: draft pilot runbook by Fri, perf doc by Wed, eval thresholds by Thu. Pilot kickoff the following week if all green.

alex: Ok locking that timeline in. Final ask: keep messaging conservative — "recommendations" not "automated tuning". We'll revisit autopilot in v2.

maya: Noted. I'll post the perf doc in the channel when ready. :calendar: 

sam: I'll export the eval deck and sample alert traces for review.

ingrid: I'll reach out to 3 candidate customers today.

alex: Thanks all — next sync in 3 days or async updates in this thread.
